required_stages.description: Allocate a fresh output of X's shape and dtype inside run().

One logical pass over exactly N elements (any split across programs or launches, no global intermediate): load, upcast to fp32, evaluate 1/(1+exp(-x)) (any equivalent formulation), downcast once, store with edge handling wherever N is not a multiple of the chosen tile.

forbidden_substitutions.message: The whole operator is performed by a PyTorch sigmoid routine.
Host-side PyTorch elementwise arithmetic computing the sigmoid outside the kernel.
The exponential appears to be evaluated in half precision; it must be fp32.
Writing into or returning the input violates the fresh-output / no-mutation rules.

required_evidence.message: No kernel-level store found; the map must be done by a kernel.
No exponential / sigmoid primitive found in the kernel.
No fp32 upcast evidence; the sigmoid must be evaluated in fp32.

outputs.aliasing: none; the returned tensor must be freshly allocated inside run() with X's shape and dtype and must not share storage with X

timing_boundary.notes: Measured: the GPU time of all device work run() launches on every call (kernels, fills, copies, casts, repacks). Host-side work in run() (the output allocation, metadata reads, Python) is not GPU time. No cached state, no copy or cast of X, no second logical pass.
